unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM workflow with role-specific generative agents to synthesize privacy-preserving synthetic EHR clinical documentation
Automated evaluation framework comparing informational and linguistic features of synthetic, anonymized, and real EHRs

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a multi-agent generative framework for synthetic clinical documentation generation, evaluating synthetic document fidelity and privacy against real EHR templates without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
